blocks.text: Bring your next idea to life.
Interactive experiences, visual production, spectacular shows and intelligent software, connected through one creative technology company.One creative technology company forinteractive experiences
Four Specialist Divisions, One Coordinated Delivery
Based in Dubai, UAE
Bringing technology, creativity and production together to help brands connect with people and bring ideas to life.
Four specialist divisions. One brief. One coordinated team from first idea to show day.

“CRUXEO Experience brings technology, creativity and production together to help brands connect with people. Clients can engage one specialist division or bring several together around one brief, with a clear scope and coordinated delivery.”
CRUXEO Experience
Creative technology and production systems trusted for live events and venues
Specialist Divisions, One Brief
Through NEXPLAY, LUMEN LAB, IGNISPECTRA and SYNAPSE, we shape interactive experiences, create visual content and environments, produce spectacular shows, and build intelligent software.
NEXPLAY by CRUXEO
Event Technology & Interactive Experiences — Play. Interact. Connect.
NEXPLAY by CRUXEO

NEXPLAY builds the interactive parts of your event: photo booths, interactive games, touch and gesture activations, AR/VR and robots that give your guests something to do, share and remember. We supply, set up and run everything on site.
LUMEN LAB by CRUXEO

LUMEN LAB makes the film, animation and show content, and supplies the screens, holograms, projectors and sound that present it. We handle content, hardware, installation and operation, so what you see on the day matches what you approved.
IGNISPECTRA by CRUXEO

IGNISPECTRA designs and runs live spectacles: drone light shows, fireworks, lasers, water screens and special effects, combined into one timed show. We plan the creative, the site, the permits and the rehearsal, then run it on the night.
SYNAPSE by CRUXEO

SYNAPSE builds the digital side of the business: AI assistants, automations, custom software and websites. We start with the problem, agree a small first version, and build from there. Where AI makes decisions, a person stays in control.
Real Projects, Coordinated Delivery
Aerial Symphony Spectacle
Coordinated aerial light show synchronised with music, architectural searchlights, and pyrotechnic accents for an evening opening ceremony.
Immersive Hologram Pavilion
Ultra-fine pitch curved LED wall paired with floating holographic fan arrays and 3D show content for a high-traffic visitor pavilion.
Interactive Radar-Touch Arena
Interactive floor and multi-touch video wall with custom branded games, welcoming thousands of visitors with zero queue bottleneck.
Enterprise AI Knowledge Assistant
Private knowledge assistant and automated qualification system answering enquiries, collecting briefs, and handing over to team leads.
How Projects Are Delivered
From brief to show day, we test every piece of hardware, content, and software before doors open. One team, clear scope, and zero surprises on site.

You tell us the goal, date, venue, and audience. We evaluate site feasibility, space, power, and regulatory requirements.

One Team. Tested Technology. Clear Delivery.
One team to brief
Clients can engage one specialist division or bring several together around one brief, with clear scope and coordinated delivery.
Clear scope and costs
Itemized, transparent quotes with upfront hardware, content, and crew specifications. No surprise fees or ambiguous add-ons.
Technology tested before show day
Displays are calibrated, flight routines simulated, and software verified in the workshop before equipment touches the venue.
A named lead for every project
Every project has a dedicated technical lead who coordinates all four divisions, ensuring seamless operation from setup to strike.
Engineered for Zero-Failure Show Delivery
Dual-Redundant Infrastructure
Zero-downtime architecture with hot-standby media servers, redundant signal paths, and backup power failovers.
Regulatory & Airspace Mastery
Full compliance management with GCAA, DCAA, civil defence, and municipal authorities across Dubai and the UAE.
Edge-First Interactive Architecture
Local GPU processing and sensor arrays that deliver ultra-low latency touch, gesture, and interactive responsiveness.
Broadcast-Calibrated Displays
High-refresh 7680Hz LED walls, floating 3D holographic fans, and projection systems color-matched to broadcast standards.
High-Throughput Guest Flow
Frictionless AI photobooths, badge printing, and registration systems designed for rapid queue clearance and sharing.
Single Technical Command
One accountable technical director orchestrating audiovisual, drone shows, activations, and software under one unified brief.
Industry-Standard Hardware & Systems
From broadcast-grade display processors to RTK drone choreographies, real-time media servers, and edge AI workstations, we deploy industry-grade hardware tested for zero-downtime execution.
Four Specialist Divisions. One Technical Command.
Interactive & Event Tech
Event technology, interactive installations, and audience participation systems.
Audiovisual & Production
Audiovisual systems, display engineering, film, and 3D visual production.
Drones & Live Shows
Drone choreography, pyrotechnics, laser displays, and show safety operations.
AI & Software
Applied AI, custom software architectures, and automated business platforms.
Show Delivery
Cross-division coordination, timecode synchronization, and show day delivery.
Four Specialist Divisions, One Delivery Team

Frequently Asked Questions
What does CRUXEO do?

CRUXEO is a Dubai creative technology company. Through four divisions we build interactive event experiences (NEXPLAY), produce film and display content (LUMEN LAB), run drone and fireworks shows (IGNISPECTRA), and create AI tools and software (SYNAPSE).
Do I need to work with all four divisions?
No. You can work with one division or combine several. When a project crosses divisions, you get one lead contact and one coordinated proposal.
How do I start a project?
Call us or connect with us on WhatsApp (+971 54 545 4891), or email info@cruxeo.com. We reply with the next step and the right person from our team.
Where do you work?
We are based in Dubai and deliver projects across the United Arab Emirates and wider region.
How much does it cost?
Costs depend on the project scale, duration, and hardware requirements, so we quote after receiving your brief. Share your project details to get a clear quotation.
Do drone light shows and pyrotechnics require permits?
Yes, shows usually require permits and venue approval. The team coordinates these and confirms feasibility for each project.
Tell us about your project
A quick chat is enough to get started. If you are not sure what you need, tell us what you have in mind and we will help you choose.
Talk to the team now
Reach our Dubai team directly. We’ll point you to the right division and the next step.

NEXPLAY by CRUXEO
Event Technology & Interactive Experiences — Play. Interact. Connect.

LUMEN LAB by CRUXEO

LUMEN LAB makes the film, animation and show content, and supplies the screens, holograms, projectors and sound that present it. We handle content, hardware, installation and operation, so what you see on the day matches what you approved.
Core Capabilities:
Indoor, outdoor, curved, transparent and floor LED displays

blocks.text: Privacy Policy
Conforming to the UAE Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021) and international data governance standards.
1. Introduction & Scope

CRUXEO Experience (“CRUXEO”, “we”, “us”) operates as a creative technology company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, delivering services across four specialist divisions: NEXPLAY, LUMEN LAB, IGNISPECTRA, and SYNAPSE. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, process, store, and safeguard business and technical information submitted through our website (cruxeo.com) and associated digital enquiry channels.
2. Information We Collect
We collect information solely to review, scope, and quote requested event productions and technical projects:
Contact Credentials: Name, business email address, phone number or WhatsApp contact handle.
Project Brief Details: Event type, target venue, anticipated dates, attendance figures, and technical rider specifications.
Technical Files & Slates: Architecture diagrams, floorplans, CAD drawings, or RFP documents voluntarily attached to enquiry submissions.
Assistant Conversations: Interactions with our technical AI assistant are processed in transient memory to help formulate briefs and are saved only upon explicit user submission.
3. Lawful Basis & Data Purpose

Under Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021, all processing is conducted under the lawful basis of contractual necessity (evaluating technical briefs, calculating engineering feasibility, preparing itemized commercial proposals) and legitimate business interest. We do not sell, rent, monetize, or exchange client data with third-party advertisers.
4. Data Retention & On-Premise Privacy

For live event activations executed by our SYNAPSE division (such as AI photobooths, generative media kiosks, and RFID leaderboards), all neural processing is performed locally on on-premise GPU workstation racks. Guest portrait data and photos are processed in volatile memory with zero unauthorized cloud storage, ensuring complete attendee confidentiality.
5. Security, Access & Inquiries

All data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS with TLS 1.3 and strict Content-Security-Policy headers. If you have questions regarding your data or wish to request data deletion, contact our data protection team directly at info@cruxeo.com or call +971 54 545 4891.
Have questions about a technical brief?
Our technical production desk is available to review your project parameters.

These Terms and Conditions govern all proposals, production riders, equipment rentals, show designs, and custom software delivery executed by CRUXEO Experience and its divisions (NEXPLAY, LUMEN LAB, IGNISPECTRA, SYNAPSE). Specific technical scopes are formally documented in an agreed Work Order or Project Rider signed by both parties.
2. Quotations, Scoping & Pricing

Due to venue-specific structural rigging limits, electrical distribution requirements, municipal permitting, and staffing days, all initial quotations are estimates based on provided briefs. Formal binding contracts require a signed statement of work following site inspection and electrical load verification.
3. Drone Shows & Aviation Clearances (IGNISPECTRA)

Drone swarm spectacles are subject to regulatory clearance from the General Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA) and/or Dubai Civil Aviation Authority (DCAA), along with local police security approvals. A minimum lead time of 4 weeks (8-12 weeks for major UAE holiday dates) is required. Operations adhere to strict safety parameters: 75m to 100m audience standoff distance and sustained wind limits up to 18-20 knots (~35 km/h).
4. Hardware Hire & Technical Riders (LUMEN LAB / NEXPLAY)

Equipment hire includes delivery, professional rigging by certified technicians, and operation during show hours. Clients are responsible for ensuring adequate three-phase power supply, safe load-in dock access, and venue security during overnight staging.
5. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These terms are governed by the federal laws of the United Arab Emirates and the local laws applicable in the Emirate of Dubai. For any commercial or contractual inquiries, reach our commercial desk at info@cruxeo.com.
